props.name: target
props.description: The scrolling element. Omit to track the window.

props.name: size
props.description: Bar thickness, or ring diameter, in pixels.

props.name: fixed
props.description: Pin to the viewport. Turn it off to place it inside a container.

props.name: position
props.description: Which edge it pins to when fixed.

props.name: showValue
props.description: Show the percentage inside the ring.

props.name: backToTop
props.description: Clicking the ring scrolls back to the start.

props.name: hideUntil
props.description: Hide the ring until there is something to show.

props.name: color
props.description: Any CSS colour for the filled portion. Defaults to the accent.

props.name: trackColor
props.description: Any CSS colour for the portion not yet read.
